# SOHO Residence & Hotel
> Boutique Serviced Apartment-Hotel in District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

## Overview
- Property: SOHO Residence & Hotel
- Address: 100 Cô Giang, Phường Cầu Ông Lãnh, Quận 1, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam
- Hotline / iMessage / Zalo / WhatsApp: +84 91 771 9966
- WeChat / KakaoTalk: sohoresidencehotel
- Email: booking@sohoresidencehotel.vn
- Official Website: https://sohoresidencehotel.vn

## Accommodations
SOHO Residence & Hotel provides 3 distinct serviced apartment categories with fully equipped kitchens, refrigerators, private balconies, and individual washing machines.

1. Studio Apartment with Balcony (30 m²)
   - URL: https://sohoresidencehotel.vn/studio
   - Layout: Open-plan space, 1 Queen bed, 1 bathroom.
   - Max Occupancy: 1–2 guests.
   - Key Features: Kitchen counter, refrigerator, private balcony with washing machine, Smart TV (guest Netflix login), free high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, smoke & CO detector.

2. 2-Bedroom Apartment with Balcony (55 m²)
   - URL: https://sohoresidencehotel.vn/2-bedroom
   - Layout: 2 separate bedrooms, 1 bathroom, dedicated living room, kitchen.
   - Max Occupancy: 3–4 guests.
   - Key Features: Living room, kitchen & fridge, private balcony with washing machine, Smart TV (guest Netflix login), free high-speed Wi-Fi, individual air conditioning, smoke & CO detector. Ideal for families and small groups.

3. 3-Bedroom Apartment with Balcony (95 m²)
   - URL: https://sohoresidencehotel.vn/3-bedroom
   - Layout: 3 separate bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, spacious living room, full kitchen.
   - Max Occupancy: 5–6 guests.
   - Key Features: 2 full bathrooms, large living area, private balcony with washing machine, Smart TV (guest Netflix login), free high-speed Wi-Fi, individual air conditioning, smoke & CO detector. Ideal for larger families and group travel.

## Key Amenities & Services
- In-unit Kitchen & Refrigerator: Standard across all residences.
- Private Washing Machine: Placed on each apartment's private balcony.
- Clothes Drying Assistance: Shared clothes dryers located in the laundry zone (contact staff for assistance; not an in-unit facility).
- Free High-Speed Wi-Fi: Throughout the entire building and inside all apartments.
- Smart TV: Supports Netflix via guests' personal login accounts.
- Safety & Security: 24/7 building security, CCTV surveillance, certified smoke and carbon monoxide (CO) alarms in every apartment.
- Free Luggage Storage: Located on the 5th floor with CCTV monitoring (contact staff for assistance).
- Check-in Procedure: 
  - Standard check-in time: from 14:00. Guests arriving after 22:00 must notify in advance.
  - Upon arrival at the lobby, guests call the hotel phone directly (+84 91 771 9966). SOHO staff will come down to assist check-in within minutes.
  - SOHO does not operate self-check-in; building security guards are not hotel personnel.

## Location & Nearby Landmarks
Located at 100 Cô Giang Street in central District 1, Ho Chi Minh City. Convenient access to:
- Bùi Viện Walking Street
- Bến Thành Market
- Nguyễn Huệ Walking Street
- Bitexco Financial Tower
- Saigon Notre-Dame Cathedral
